name: Mulberry Tree
overview: The mulberry tree in Scripture serves as a significant landmark in God's guidance and protection. In 2 Samuel 5, the LORD directs David to approach the enemy by way of the mulberry trees, promising victory as He goes before him to strike down the Philistines. Psalm 84 also uses the imagery of the mulberry trees, or valley of Baca, as a place of refreshment and provision, symbolizing the sustaining care of God even in difficult journeys.
